subject.title: Embedded runner: freshly streamed thinking signatures intermittently invalid on replay (Anthropic); recovery wrapper never fires because error text is genericized

question: Should this broad issue remain the umbrella until all Anthropic signed-thinking replay variants are resolved, or should maintainers make a narrower issue such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/94228 or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/99382 canonical now that the recovery-carrier fixes are on main?
rationale: The remaining fix changes Anthropic thinking replay policy and has competing open PR shapes, so automation should not close or create another repair without maintainer direction.

options.title: Keep umbrella open
options.body: Leave this issue open until a chosen prevention PR lands or maintainers explicitly split the remaining variants.

options.title: Promote focused canonical issue
options.body: Close this issue as superseded only after posting a clear handoff to the focused prevention issue and its active PR.

options.title: Accept recovery-only scope
options.body: Treat the merged recovery fixes as sufficient for this issue and defer prevention policy to a separate provider replay review.

recommendation.title: Keep umbrella open
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open until a chosen prevention PR lands or maintainers explicitly split the remaining variants.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already summarized the recovery half as landed and the create/prevention half as still open in this issue discussion.
